CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation present to bind with identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue positions), organization (node grouping of red/blue) and provenance/status (origin) are explicitly co-located for p0/current/n2.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to content presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (colour + coordinate sets) are listed.

D.rationale: Origins/provenance entries explicitly distinguish content identity from status/source (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate).

O.rationale: The report explicitly presents content organized into nodes and candidates, with inherited/current origin structure.
